checks.primer3_dg_unit: primer3 dg is cal/mol; values above are divided by 1000
checks.thermo_note: DNA Design Suite uses SantaLucia 1998 Table 2 at 1 M Na+ and 1 uM strand, with no divalent ions. Biopython defaults are 50 mM Na+, Owczarzy saltcorr=5, 25 nM. primer3 defaults add 1.5 mM divalent and 0.6 mM dNTP. Hairpin loop initiation is not in the bundled Table 2, so hairpin ΔG is not expected to match primer3.

pair.parameter_citation: SantaLucia J Jr. A unified view of polymer, dumbbell, and oligonucleotide DNA nearest-neighbor thermodynamics. Proc Natl Acad Sci USA. 1998;95(4):1460-1465. Table 2, unified oligonucleotide ΔH° and ΔS° NN parameters in 1 M NaCl. Free full text: PMC19045.
